proposition: Bākharzī's account is tendentious: it serves later Naqshbandi efforts to distance themselves from the more intellectual and suspect Isfahan Circle, portraying its members as inexpert, possibly heterodox, court-dependent failed Sufis (MK's judgement of the account's aim).

mediation.note: MK's paraphrase of the account's implied line is ironic; the 'may well have deserved the accusations' sentence is a description of Bākharzī's stance, not MK's
